name: chute_porch_bay1
_why: the 40 degree porch leg of the crossing chute (D36: it is the ramp's own angle now, so tray A's feed is one straight chute), in the right-hand lane of bay 1, under tray B's flat-bridged floor (D29). A blocked lane would leave the part watertight and single-bodied, which is exactly why no other check would notice.

name: chute_ramp_bay1
_why: the 40 degree leg, from the end of the porch out into hopper A's mouth: about 105mm enclosed under tray B and under hopper B's ramp. If anything closes this, half the bays silently stop feeding.

name: chute_porch_bay5
_why: the same porch lane in the far bay

name: chute_ramp_bay5
_why: the same ramp leg in the bay the right-hand rail buttress intrudes into

name: outlet_trayA_bay1
_why: tray A's outlet: from inside the tray, up the tilted floor (D36), under the wall that separates it from tray B, into the chute. The old straight horizontal line at z = 15 would now run into the tilted floor.

name: outlet_trayB_bay5
_why: tray B's outlet: from inside the tray, under hopper B's front wall, into hopper B. z = 127: above hopper B's ramp (110.0 at the tray's back wall, 122.4 by y = 100) and below the outlet top at 137.0.

name: rail_groove_front
_why: the front joining groove must be open from its floor OUT OF THE TOP of the side wall, or a neighbouring module's rail cannot be lowered in. Its top is the pick plane over tray A, which is highest at the groove's back edge (about 104.3). This line ends at 108, in open air above the plane. D39 thickened the skin behind the groove and lengthened the buttress; this proves the groove is still open end to end.

name: rail_groove_back
_why: same for the back groove: ends at 192, in open air above the rim (189) and the groove top (190), so the exit is what is tested

name: porch_centre_bay3
_why: down the centre line of bay 3's porch, where the splitter rib stood until revision 8 (D29). A rib put back, or a porch ceiling sagging to the floor, would block this line while leaving the part watertight and single-bodied.
